title: LEGACY V2 Raven Wire Receipt (NOT receipt-v1)
description: LEGACY V2 COMPATIBILITY schema for the signed object returned by POST /verify and archived in /receipt-test-vector.json (vector.receipt). It is not the current receipt-v1 customer wire contract and is not recommended for new integrations. Current integrations use POST /receipt/v1 and /receipt-v1-test-vector.json with the maintained raven-receipt-verifier. For persisting an archived legacy v2 receipt, use /receipt-schema.json. The legacy signing contract is unchanged: its ed25519 signature covers the canonical preimage recipe published in the legacy vector, not this document.
$comment: LEGACY V2 only. Forward-compatible: additionalProperties stays true so future informational legacy fields do not break third-party validators. The one hard prohibition: 'unsigned' must NEVER appear inside the legacy receipt object. In POST /verify, 'unsigned' appears as a sibling key alongside the receipt fields — the object that this schema validates is the response body WITH that top-level annotation removed. The annotation carries no receipt authority.

engineOutcome.description: The engine's pass/fail outcome, or null. A legitimate "unknowable" receipt (e.g. RPC unreachable) carries engineOutcome:null — see SolanaEngineOutcome | null in the contract — so null MUST validate here.

triggeringFindingCodes.description: Finding codes that determined the verdict. Informational-only evidence (e.g. launch.*) must never appear here.

coverageGaps.description: Normative. Must never be summarized away. The authoritative limitation list for this receipt.

rpc.description: Read context for the verification. observedSlot lives HERE (rpc.observedSlot), not at the receipt top level.

signature.description: Base64 ed25519 signature over the published canonical preimage recipe. Verify against an independently pinned signer key — the embedded attestationPublicKey is convenience-only and MUST be cross-checked against the pinned key, never trusted alone. GET /pubkey (see agents.json attestation.publicKeyEndpoint) is same-host discovery/cross-check material only.

attestationPublicKey.description: Convenience copy of the signing public key (base64 SPKI DER). NOT an authority by itself: cross-check keyId and served key material against your independently pinned key before trusting; /pubkey alone is discovery, not a trust root.
